message:
Now let me compile this test harness with ASAN against the leptonica library.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>
cd /workspace && g++ -std=c++11 -g -fsanitize=address -I/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/include -I/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/leptonica/src test_fuzzer.cc -o test_fuzzer /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lib/liblept.a /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libtiff.a /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libwebp.a /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libpng16.a /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libjpeg.a /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libjbig.a /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libzstd.a /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lib/libz.a -lm -lpthread 2>&1 | head -30
</parameter>
